about.text: A small, soft Brie-type cheese related to Coulommiers, from Seine-et-Marne in Île-de-France. Rennet is added to warmed milk, the curd is ladled into moulds and dry-salted, and it is sprayed with Penicillium candidum and aged three to four weeks.

sources.text: The milk, the process, the origin and the farm sites.
